claims.statement: For T_v consisting of adjacent hubs with one pendant leaf at one hub and v pendant leaves at the other, v>=8, the complete strict favorable-leaf sum is nonpositive for every p satisfying x(T_v)+2<=p and 3p<2alpha(T_v)+1.
claims.scope: The stated uneven two-hub family only; alpha(T_v)=v+1, original leaf tags retain multiplicity, and the selector is exactly Delta_p(T_v-leaf)<0.
claims.reason: Exact binomial formulas prove x(T_v)>=ceil(v/2)-1, strict favorability of every original leaf under the eligible lower bound, and nonpositive support differences at rank p-1; summing all distinct tags gives S= v(q_p-q_(p-1))<=0. An exact eligible v=11 row is also supplied.

limitations: This proof covers only the uneven two-hub family with leaf multiplicities 1 and v; arbitrary trees and general multi-hub families remain unresolved.
No universal verdict for the primary registered aggregate follows from this subfamily result.
